articles.title: Ostium suffers $18 million exploit as oracle attack wave continues to hit DeFi
articles.snippet: A hacker used Ostium's own price-reporting infrastructure against the protocol, submitting falsified future-dated oracle data to manufacture fake trading profits and trigger an $18 million payout.

articles.title: South Korea to modify 76-year-old law to classify cryptocurrencies as national assets
articles.snippet: The government also reaffirmed plans to pilot tokenized government bonds next year and explore tokenizing state-owned real estate.

articles.title: Ostium pauses trading as security firms report multimillion-dollar oracle exploit
articles.snippet: Ostium halted trading and advised revoking contract approvals after blockchain security firms reported an apparent oracle-related exploit of its OLP liquidity vault, with estimated losses ranging from $18 million to $22 million.

articles.title: JCB signs Circle MOU to test stablecoin payments in Japan
articles.snippet: The companies will explore using USDC for JCB’s cross-border treasury operations and merchant payments in Japan as regulated stablecoin adoption gains momentum.

articles.title: Humanity Protocol to prioritize operational security following $36M hack
articles.snippet: Humanity Protocol’s founder said they will refocus on operational security, as malicious actors are switching from smart contract vulnerabilities to exploiting human behavior.
